# Macmillan Learning

> Macmillan Learning provides comprehensive digital learning platforms, interactive tools, and textbooks across multiple academic disciplines for higher education institutions.

Macmillan Learning serves college instructors and students with an integrated suite of products including Achieve (learning platform), iClicker (classroom engagement), LaunchPad (course materials hub), and discipline-specific resources. The platform combines adaptive learning, AI-powered tutoring, interactive labs, and LMS integration to support teaching and learning across sciences, business, humanities, and professional fields.

## Key Topics

- Achieve Platform
- iClicker
- LaunchPad
- AI Tutor
- Digital Learning Platform
- LMS Integration
- E-books

- Higher Education

## Core Platforms & Store

- [Macmillan Learning US | Digital Learning Tools & Classroom Solutions](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us): Main college portal showcasing Macmillan Learning's digital learning tools, products, and classroom solutions.
- [Macmillan Learning Student Store | Rent or Buy Textbooks](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us): Student store for purchasing or renting textbooks, e-books, and digital course materials.

## Science & Engineering Disciplines

- [Anatomy and Physiology Lab Resources | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/Anatomy & Physiology): Anatomy & Physiology discipline hub with interactive labs, assessments, and visual tools.
- [Interactive Astronomy Tools & Resources | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/Astronomy): Astronomy discipline hub featuring interactive models, AI Tutor, and adaptive learning tools.
- [Biochemistry Teaching Tools and Resources | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/Biochemistry): Biochemistry discipline hub with interactive labs, AI Tutor, and instructor resources.
- [Bring Biology to Life—Help Students See, Interact, and Understand | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/Biology): Biology discipline hub with interactive tools connecting concepts to real-world applications.
- [Chemistry That Connects—From Lectures and Labs to Everyday Life | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/Chemistry): Chemistry discipline hub with AI-driven support and interactive tools for chemistry learning.
- [Environmental Science Teaching Resources | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/Environmental Science): Environmental Science discipline hub with interactive activities, case studies, and AI Tutor.
- [Electrical Engineering Textbooks for Instructors | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/Electrical Engineering): Electrical Engineering discipline hub with textbooks and instructor resources.
- [Interactive Geography Tools & Resources | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/Geography): Geography discipline hub featuring ArcGIS integration, AI Tutor, and adaptive resources.

## Business & Social Sciences Disciplines

- [Teaching Business in HigherEd | Learning Tools & Simulations | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/Business): Business discipline hub featuring experiential learning tools and decision-making simulations.
- [Economics: From Theory to Real-World Impact | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/Economics): Economics discipline hub connecting economic concepts to real-world applications.

## Humanities & Student Success Disciplines

- [English Tools that Empower Student Writers | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/English): English discipline hub with writing tools and classroom solutions for student writers.
- [Communication Teaching Tools and Resources | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/Communication): Communication discipline hub with teaching resources and practical communication tools.
- [College Success Resources & Tools | Macmillan Learning US](https://www.macmillanlearning.com/college/us/discipline/College Success): College Success discipline hub offering readiness tools and strategies for first-year students.
